title: AgentOS Capability v0
description: Agent identity and capability model (protocol asset P2). Answers three questions: who is this agent (key identity), what was it granted (capability package), and why is it trustworthy (signature chain). v0 fixes the minimal loop: a capability is a signed policy. v1 extends to tool/driver/verifier packages (a neutral counterpart to Octopus SKILL.md and ANOLISA SkillFS).

capability_id.description: Globally unique capability id, e.g. 'invoice-organizer' or 'fs-workspace-ro'

agent_key.description: ed25519 public key (base64) of the grantee — the agent's identity

grants.description: Granted capabilities; in v0 each entry embeds one policy object

policy.description: Policy object (agentos.policy.v0), reviewed by the issuer

issued_by.description: Issuer (a human or a parent agent) — the previous link in the signature chain

signature.description: ed25519 signature over canonical(this object without the signatures field), base64

kind.description: kind=human means issued by a human. Verifier-type capability packages require at least one human signature — an institutional guardrail: agents cannot grant acceptance authority to agents
